whatsapp.title: WhatsApp, SMS and email
whatsapp.subtitle: Who gets which message · only people who opted in · every message logged on its record
whatsapp.sendingOff: Sending is off. Messages are written to the outbox when a document is posted, but nothing is sent until the WhatsApp Business account is connected and the whatsapp-sender Edge Function is deployed. Until then they stay queued, or skipped with the reason.
whatsapp.waStep3: Sign-in code and message templates approved
whatsapp.emailStep2: Domain check so mail is not marked spam
whatsapp.adminOnly: Only Admin changes messaging. Ask Admin.
whatsapp.templatesNote: Utility templates only. Meta approves each template; a change to an approved template becomes a new draft version. Staff messages never carry amounts, salary, KYC or bank details.
whatsapp.templateHelp: Write {{p1}}, {{p2}} … in the body, one for each parameter, in order.

f.name: Template name
f.nameHelp: Lower case letters, digits and _ only
f.paramsHelp: Names in order, separated by commas

whatsapp.allowNote: Outside production, messages may go only to these numbers. A number is accepted only if it belongs to a customer or supplier contact who agreed to WhatsApp, or to a staff member with their own sign-in. Typed numbers are refused.
whatsapp.removeEffect: Messages in development and preview will no longer go to {{number}}.
whatsapp.noAllowBody: Add the number of a contact who agreed to WhatsApp to try messages outside production.
whatsapp.outboxNote: One row per message, written in the same step as the document. The message values are not shown here.
whatsapp.noOutboxBody: Posting an invoice, a receipt or a payroll writes messages here.
whatsapp.cancelEffect: The {{template}} message to {{to}} will not be sent. The row stays in the outbox as cancelled, with your reason.
whatsapp.noInboundBody: Replies from customers arrive here once the WhatsApp Business account and its webhook are connected.
whatsapp.channelsNote: One WhatsApp Business number per company is recommended; the owner decides. A number shows Connected only when the sender is live.
whatsapp.noChannelsBody: Add each company's number once Meta business verification is done.
whatsapp.channelHelp: The access token is never entered here; it is kept only in the Edge Function secrets.
whatsapp.statusHelp: Connected is set when the sender goes live.

rules.not_consented: This number is not a contact who agreed to WhatsApp. Record the consent on the customer, supplier or staff record first.
rules.staff_template_private: Staff messages may not carry amounts, salary, KYC or bank details. Link to the staff app instead.
rules.template_params: Put one {{marker}} in the body for each parameter, in order.
rules.template_body: A template needs an event and a message body.
rules.template_missing: That template no longer exists. Reload the page.

p6.tasksNote: A photo, a document or a message saying it is paid becomes an urgent payment-proof task for finance, checked against the bank; only finance or Admin closes it. Other messages ask for a reply from finance or the customer's salesperson. Messages show here with the number masked.
p6.noTasksBody: Tasks appear when a customer writes in. Until the WhatsApp webhook is connected, Admin can record a received message above.
p6.recordNote: Until the WhatsApp webhook is connected, Admin can enter a message a customer sent. The number is matched to the customer's contact; STOP opts the number out and cancels queued messages.
p6.companyFromOutbox: From the last message sent to this number
p6.recordedStop: Recorded · the number has opted out (STOP)
p6.proofEffect: Closes the payment-proof task. Check the payment in the bank statement first; receipts are posted on the Receipts screen.
p6.replyEffect: Closes the task. Add a note for the record if useful.
p6.replyHelp: A free-text reply goes only inside the 24-hour window (until {{until}}) and only to a number that agreed to WhatsApp. Never write salary, KYC or bank details.
p6.capsNote: Each message gets an estimated cost from the rate below. At the alert % an alert is recorded; at the cap, reminders and statements are skipped with the reason, while invoices, receipts, credit notes and delivery messages still go.
p6.noCapsBody: Without a cap nothing is stopped for cost. Admin sets one per company.
p6.ratesNote: Enter the provider's price per message for each category, from the date it applies. None is preset.
p6.noRatesBody: Until a rate is entered, messages carry no estimated cost and caps cannot be reached.
p6.costTitle: Messages and estimated cost by month
p6.scheduleDays: A reminder goes {{days}} the due date of a bill (Settings: msg.reminder_days).
p6.scheduleUnset: No reminder schedule is set. Admin sets msg.reminder_days on Settings.
p6.ruleConsent: Only contacts who agreed to WhatsApp get one; others are recorded as skipped with the reason.
p6.ruleOnce: One summary message per customer per day, never twice.
p6.ruleGst: GST bills only; bills without GST are never put in a reminder.
p6.ruleDisputed: A disputed bill (open complaint or billing query) pauses until it is settled.
p6.ruleProof: A pending payment proof holds the reminder for that customer.
p6.ruleSettled: A bill paid in full cancels its queued reminder.
p6.ruleCap: When the company's monthly cost cap is reached, reminders are skipped with the reason.
p6.scheduleJob: The daily job runs at 08:00 IST and messages go out from 10:00 IST once sending is connected.
p6.runNote: Queues today's reminders for one company now (the daily job does this every morning). Running it again the same day adds nothing.
p6.runNoSchedule: No reminder schedule is set, so nothing was queued.
p6.runNoRight: Admin or accounts staff with receipt rights run reminders. The daily job runs them every morning.
p6.noRemindersBody: Reminders appear when a GST bill reaches a day on the schedule.

rules.task_missing: That task no longer exists. Reload the page.
rules.task_finance_only: A payment proof is checked by finance against the bank. Ask finance or Admin to close it.
rules.msg_inbound_missing: That message no longer exists. Reload the page.
rules.msg_window_closed: The 24-hour reply window has closed. Use an approved template instead.
rules.msg_not_consented: This number has not agreed to WhatsApp, so no reply can be sent.
